name: Shoya Kenjou
source:
Main character receives a letter about his grandfather illness. He arrives to the mansion in the mountains and gets to live there for a month in the company of women of the house.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角收到一封信，得知祖父病重。他赶到深山里的宅邸，并与屋中的女性们共同生活一个月。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
